li.label: Crawling
li.description: The walls of flesh are closing in. I need to leave. Now.

li.label: Wrong
li.description: Everything here is wrong. This place is feeding on me.

li.label: Swallowing
li.description: It's pulling me deeper. I'm becoming part of it!

li.label: Consuming
li.description: THE FLESH IS INSIDE ME. I can't stop it!

li.label: Unsettling warmth
li.description: The air is too warm and sweet here. Something feels off.

li.label: Too much
li.description: I'm getting fuller and I don't want to be.

li.label: Excess
li.description: This place is making me fat. I hate it.

li.label: Burdened
li.description: I can't stop swelling. Get me out!

li.label: Curious
li.description: The void hums. I don't know what to make of it.

li.label: Hungry
li.description: I feel hungrier than I should.

li.label: Swelling
li.description: I keep growing. I'm not sure I like it.

li.label: Too much
li.description: This place fills me faster than I can accept.

li.label: Curious
li.description: The void whispers. Nothing more.

li.label: Hungry
li.description: I feel a strange appetite here.

li.label: Filling
li.description: I'm filling out more than usual.

li.label: Insatiable
li.description: I can't stop eating while I'm here.

li.label: Cozy
li.description: The warmth here feels comforting.

li.label: Comfortably full
li.description: Everything here makes me comfortably full.

li.label: Pleasing plump
li.description: I like the way I'm filling out.

li.label: Blissful binge
li.description: The void feeds me and I love it.

li.label: Pleasant hum
li.description: The void hums in a way I enjoy.

li.label: Growing nicely
li.description: I'm getting bigger and it feels great.

li.label: More of me
li.description: More of me to love. The void knows what I want.

li.label: Ecstatic growth
li.description: I can hardly contain how good this feels!

li.label: Belonging
li.description: The void understands me.

li.label: Feeding
li.description: It feeds me so well. I keep growing.

li.label: Union
li.description: I'm becoming something beautiful.

li.label: Blissful infinitude
li.description: THE VOID FLOWS THROUGH ME. GROW. MORE!

li.label: Communion
li.description: The void calls me home.

li.label: Feasting
li.description: I feast endlessly. I grow endlessly.

li.label: Transcendence
li.description: No limit can hold me. The void affirms me!

li.label: Infinite
li.description: I AM BECOMING INFINITE. GROW. CONSUME. GROW!

li.label: Tingling
li.description: Something is moving inside me... it tickles.

li.label: Warm expansion
li.description: The warmth inside is spreading. I feel myself getting heavier. Fuller.

li.label: Pleasurable swelling
li.description: Every moment the meld grows, I feel more... complete. Is this what I was missing?

li.label: Blissful merger
li.description: I don't know where I end and the meld begins. We are becoming something beautiful together.

li.label: Ecstatic union
li.description: THE VOID FLOWS THROUGH ME. I AM BECOMING INFINITE. MELD WITH ME. GROW WITH ME. YES!
